    1. handleItemDrop(String, JPanel, T)

Interface DropListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
EquipmentController
public interface DropListener
Interface defining the contract for objects that manage and respond to item drop events within the graphical user interface, typically involving equipment or inventory management.

Implementing classes are responsible for executing the business logic associated with equipping or unequipping an item, based on the drop source and target.

  • Method Details

    • handleItemDrop

      <T extends Item> void handleItemDrop(String panelType, JPanel target, T item)
      Processes the dropping of an Item, executing the logic for equipping, unequipping, or transferring the item between slots.
      Type Parameters:
      T - The specific type of Item being handled.
      Parameters:
      panelType - The category or type identifier of the item (e.g., "Armor", "Weapon", "Potion").
      target - The destination graphical slot (represented by JPanel) where the item was dropped. This parameter is null if the item was deliberately removed or unequipped from an existing slot.
      item - The specific Item instance that was dropped.
